description: This Java class `IncomingDataBuffer` provides a thread-safe buffer for managing incoming byte data, supporting blocking reads with timeout, buffer overflow handling, and data retrieval methods.

classes.name: IncomingDataBuffer
classes.description: A thread-safe byte queue buffer that handles incoming data with blocking capabilities and overflow management.

methods.name: IncomingDataBuffer
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the buffer and logger.

methods.name: addData
methods.description: Adds new byte data to the buffer, logs info, and handles overflow by clearing buffer.

methods.name: waitForBytes
methods.description: Blocks until the specified number of bytes is available or timeout occurs, with informative logging.

methods.name: dropPending
methods.description: Drops any pending data in the buffer and logs this event.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Retrieves a 2-byte short from the buffer, throws EOFException if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieves a 4-byte int from the buffer, throws EOFException if unsuccessful.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Copies data from the buffer into the provided byte array.
